module: Flowgraph node "Particle Emitter" (repeat_instant, author BeamNG). Creates a ParticleEmitterNode object (emitter BNGP_confetti, dataBlock lightExampleEmitterNodeData1) added to the MissionGroup and positions it. Inputs: clear (impulse), position (vec3), rotation (quat), color. Output: flow.
notes: Bug: _afterTrigger calls self:hideobject() (lowercase) whereas the method is hideObject: Lua error if this branch runs.
Bug: fillFields reads self.pinIn.radius, but no 'radius' pin is declared in pinSchema.
Bug: setPosition tests self.object.objBase which is never defined: the position is therefore never applied.
The rotation and color pins are not used by the code.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Initializes position, radius, clr, object and shown.

createObject.desc: Creates the ParticleEmitterNode (canSave = false) and registers it under the given name.

objectName.desc: name of the object in the scene

showObject.desc: Shows the existing object or creates it (name particles__<time>_<id>) and adds it to scenetree.MissionGroup.

hideObject.desc: Hides the object (hidden = true) and sets shown to false.

_afterTrigger.desc: After the trigger: if the input flow is false and the emitter is shown, tries to hide it.

_executionStopped.desc: On stop: removes the object from the editor tree if possible, deletes it and resets the state to zero.

fillFields.desc: Reads position/radius/color from the pins with default values (radius 2, color {1,0,0,0.8}).

setPosition.desc: Positions and scales (radius, radius, 50) the object.

work.desc: Creates/shows the emitter; on flow, shows and positions it (flow output true); on clear, hides it (flow output false).

destroy.desc: Called when the node is destroyed: deletes the emitter.
